trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Dharwad (Matrimonial Case No. 94/2023)
case_name: Smt Deepika W/O Shivaprakash Hiremath vs Shri Shivaprakash S/O Shadaxarayya

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Deepika W/O Shivaprakash Hiremath, wife

facts_of_case: The parties are husband and wife who got married in 2020. Due to an un-cordial relationship, they are living separately. The husband has filed a petition for divorce under Section 13(1)(ia) & (ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The wife seeks to withdraw the proceedings and transfer them to the Family Court, Bengaluru.

legal_principles.principle: When a wife seeks transfer, convenience of the wife needs to be considered.
legal_principles.held: The convenience of the wife must be looked into.
cited_cases: Sumita Singh Vs. Kumar Sanjay and another, (Year) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: The justice demands that when a wife seeks transfer, the convenience of the wife is to be looked.
legal_principles.held: The justice demand that when the wife seeks transfer, convenience of the wife is to be looked.

outcome.final_order: The court directed the transfer of the proceedings from the Principal Judge, Family Court, Dharwad to the Family Court, Bengaluru.

use_for_drafting: advising on transfer of proceedings in a matrimonial dispute
assisting with a civil petition under Section 24 CPC
